en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked himasws about a man whose wife divorced herself by Khul’a from him, is it permissible for him that he proposes to her sister from before she has fulfilled her waiting period?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, she has disavowed her marriage from him and there is no reversion for him to her’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Basir who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man whose wife has arranged al- Khul‘: if it is permissible for him to propose marriage to her sister before waiting period because of al-KhuV is complete. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, because she has freed herself from the bonds of his marriage and he does not have the right to go back to her.’”
